title: Treasure of Wisdom: A New Plan
description: Drusus, a researcher who loves riddles, seems to have a new idea recently...

mainQuestExcel.title: Treasure of Wisdom: A New Plan
mainQuestExcel.description: Drusus, a researcher who loves riddles, seems to have a new idea recently...

dialogs.text: Oh, this is a good one...
Are you working on your riddles again?
Traveler! You've come at the right time! I'm about to design a whole new series of riddles.
The terrain here is a little complicated. See, there is a huge root of the Divine Tree entering the water from one side of the harbor.
On the other side is a huge lotus leaf, and a lot of ships waiting to leave the harbor.
Traveler, which side do you feel is better as the theme for this riddle?
It's better to start with the root system.
Really? The huge root system of the Divine Tree is quite conspicuous, and easily seen as the "entry point" of the riddle.
Okay! I'll write a riddle with the root system as the theme.
Hehe, let me write something.
Hehe, leave it to me.
Hey! Why are you grinning like that!?
Done. Here, have a look.
"Where knowledge returns to the sea, treasure lies along the sails."
It reads well! And this riddle also makes people think of "port" really easily...
And when it's put with "where knowledge returns to the sea," it's easy to see that the location is related to the Akademiya or Sumeru City...
I never knew you had such a talent.
Wait a minute, I'll paste this riddle in a place where it can be easily discovered...
Huh? Paste it in this area? But the location in the riddle is not that far away. It might be solved right away.
Hahaha, I'm giving the riddle solver a range to solve the riddles in.
If I don't do this, then the range will be too big.
Drusus starts putting up the riddle...
Okay, the riddle for this area is done. Let's go to the next place.
Eh? There's another place...?
The lotus leaf and ships are interesting.
Indeed... It could be fun in another sense if we link the two.
No problem, I'll just make a riddle with this theme.
These are too easy!
Too easy? What ideas do you have then?

flow.stepDescription: Set up the riddles with Drusus

dialogs.text: Okay! Let's set up the second riddle here. Once this riddle is solved, the final chest can be found.
I'm going to place the final treasure... there.
Huh...
Um...
Isn't this just an ordinary little hill with an ordinary little waterfall next to it?
That's right! But it will soon be anything but ordinary because of our riddles.
Okay, Traveler, what do you suggest for this riddle?
Let's make it a bit straightforward this time...
Eh? You think so? Hm... True, the riddle solvers would be pretty tired when they get here...
Alright, straightforward it is.
Not exactly trained for it...
Well, practice makes perfect...
I see. As expected of the Traveler! How knowledgeable... Okay, I will put up the riddle you wrote here.
Drusus starts putting up the riddle...
Done! This little notice board should be obvious enough.
Then let's go set up the last treasure chest now.
Let's use the waterfall as a theme.
Hmm... The waterfall is indeed a very clear theme.
No problem, let's use it as a theme. As for the difficulty of this last riddle... Let's tone it down a bit.
Hehe, let me write something.
Hey! You're laughing more and more!
It's done.
"The green umbrella gazes at the pearl curtain."
Hm... This riddle sounds special... Did you learn this from somewhere?

flow.stepDescription: Set up the treasure with Drusus

dialogs.text: This is the last chest. There's no need for riddles for this one.
But what should I put in it...
Something valuable enough.
That makes sense. The content of this chest should be at least worthy of the riddle solver's hard thinking along their journey.
Speaking of value, the most logical would be Mora, of course. Ah, I'll just put some Mora in there...
Okay, this set of riddles is finished now. Thank you for your help, Traveler.
These are for you, as a reward.
*sigh* I was planning on discussing riddles with you in more depth, but I have to return to the Akademiya to tend to some matters first.
If you discover any strange new riddles in your travels, or get stumped by one, please come to me by all means.
We can discuss them in detail together, then... Put together new riddles for other adventurers! Hahaha!
Farewell, Traveler. I wish you safe travels.
I hope that Treasure Hoarder named Narzam won't cause any serious trouble...
Something of practical value.
Practical value? Hm... What can be of enough practical value?
Oh right! I got a recipe from someone a few days ago. Let's put it in this chest as a reward.
This process of thought is the greatest treasure.
Hahahahaha! You're right! So true! The thinking process is indeed a priceless and valuable experience! Compared to it, other things are almost worthless.
That's simply not true! Put some Mora in it, or a recipe! Some vegetables or fruits at the very least, don't put nothing!
I'm kidding, I'm kidding. I'll definitely put something in as a reward.
"Test the shallow seas with this branch of wisdom."
"A smart plant that is good at trading water droplets."
"Where knowledge returns to the sea, treasure lies along the sails."
"Above the stream running, under the trees green."
"Thoughts flow freely, and wisdom halts on the shore, pondering."
"The green umbrella gazes at the pearl curtain."
